title: Legal Notice and Authenticity
intro: The SARI Système SARL authenticity verification system guarantees the origin and validity of all official documents and products issued by our company. Each document contains a unique code in the format
andKey: and an encrypted verification key allowing instant authentication.
legalValueDesc: Documents verified as authentic by this system have full legal and commercial value under current Algerian legislation. In case of dispute, the positive verification result is proof of the document's authenticity before competent jurisdictions.
antiCounterfeitDesc: SARI Système SARL is actively committed to fighting the counterfeiting of documents and medical products. Any document not recognized or reported as forged by our verification system must be considered suspicious and reported to our services as well as to the competent authorities.
dataProtectionDesc: Verification information is processed confidentially and is not stored beyond the verification session. In accordance with
lawDesc: relating to the protection of natural persons in the processing of personal data, no personal data is retained during the verification process.
warningDesc: Forgery of official documents is an offense punishable by criminal prosecution under the Algerian Penal Code (Articles 214, 217 and 147). If in doubt about the authenticity of a document, contact our services immediately or the competent judicial authorities.
